column1: # Conversational usage notes v1.1.5 — original source expressions, not replacements.

column5: In the source scheduling exchange, this means that a slightly later time is not good. A more explicit way to say that the time is inconvenient is 过一会儿不方便 (guò yíhuìr bù fāngbiàn). The 儿化 (érhuà) ending in 一会儿 (yíhuìr) reflects northern-leaning spoken usage.
Placing 现在 (xiànzài) after 要 (yào) gives extra emphasis to eating now rather than later. For a neutral statement, 我现在要吃午饭 (wǒ xiànzài yào chī wǔfàn) is more common.
Placing 现在 (xiànzài) after 想 (xiǎng) highlights the desired time: now rather than later. The more neutral order is 我现在想吃午饭 (wǒ xiànzài xiǎng chī wǔfàn).

column3: wǒ bù xiǎng gēn nǐ yìqǐ hē
column5: The object of 喝 (hē) is understood if the speakers already know what drink is being discussed. Without that context, the refusal sounds abrupt or incomplete. A softer, more explicit alternative is 我今天不太想跟你一起喝茶 (wǒ jīntiān bú tài xiǎng gēn nǐ yìqǐ hē chá).

column3: nǐ bù xiǎng gēn wǒ yìqǐ hē
column5: The drink after 喝 (hē) is omitted because it is understood from the conversation. As an isolated sentence this can sound abrupt. A more explicit form is 你不想跟我一起喝茶 (nǐ bù xiǎng gēn wǒ yìqǐ hē chá).
